notes:
Context: Rivermark Questify is an SMB (support-focused KM product) building a doc-search/RAG layer for mid-market customers. They currently use Pinecone + a mix of locally-hosted embedding jobs (batch) and on-the-fly reranking.

Key asks: low-friction hosted API that plugs into their existing vector DB flow, predictable embedding pricing for batch runs, and per-request latency under ~200ms for user-facing search. Want examples of embedding + rerank patterns (client-side prefix caching, async batch updates).

From discovery call: CTO quote: "We need something simple we can drop in — devs hate ops — but cost needs to be predictable once we ramp." Also: engineering prefers Python SDK; product team cares about quality regressions after model updates.

Technical details: currently using OpenAI text-embedding-3-small locally for nightly indexing (approx 20k docs/day), Pinecone replica for nearest-neighbors. Frontend issues: sporadic latency spikes, inconsistent rerank quality after prompt tweaks. They want a hosted API endpoint to handle embeddings and a low-latency generation model for reranking/summarization.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required for customers; SSO for workspace; legal asked about EU data residency for a subset of customers (they serve EU SMBs). Will need audit logs for user requests during POC.

POC goals: 1) Embedding throughput test (5k docs/hour) with cost estimate, 2) Reranking A/B vs current reranker (improve MRR on search CTR), 3) Latency SLO verification (p95 < 200ms).
